Act8-1#1.zh: 我等犯了权臣高俅，不得不流浪山野！然而妻子家小，无处投奔；闻柴大官人急公好义、见义勇为，天下好汉莫不称道。望拜见柴大官人一面，再做打算！
Act8-1#1.t: We have offended the powerful minister Gao Qiu and must wander the wilds! But our wives and families have nowhere to go. We hear Lord Chai is generous and righteous, praised by every hero in the land. We hope to meet Lord Chai before deciding what to do!

Act8-1#2.zh: 只见一位官人，生得龙眉凤目，皓齿朱唇，三牙掩口髭须，三十四五年纪。
Act8-1#2.t: Out came a gentleman with dragon brows and phoenix eyes, white teeth and red lips, a moustache over his mouth, some thirty-four or thirty-five years old.

Act8-1#3.zh: 小可就是柴进。诸位英雄到此，柴进未曾远迎，请当面恕罪。
Act8-1#3.t: I am Chai Jin. Heroes have come and I failed to meet you on the road. Please forgive me.

Act8-1#4.zh: 小人是东京禁军教头，姓林名冲；因为妻子被高俅义子高衙内看上，所以高俅欲害我性命，在下不得不逃离东京。林冲一人流浪江湖是无所谓；但是妻小却无处安身...
Act8-1#4.t: I am Lin Chong, an instructor of the Imperial Guard in Kaifeng. Young Master Gao, Gao Qiu's adopted son, set his eyes on my wife, so Gao Qiu wants me dead, and I had to flee the capital. I don't mind wandering alone, but my wife and household have nowhere to stay...

Act8-1#5.zh: 您就是八十万禁军教头『豹子头』林冲吧！小可久闻教头大名，只是无缘相会；不期教头今日来踏贱地，足称在下平生渴仰之愿！
Act8-1#5.t: So you are Lin Chong, the 'Panther Head', instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards! I've long heard your name but never had the chance to meet you. That you've come to my humble home today fulfils a lifelong wish!

Act8-1#6.zh: 柴大官人言重了。在下不过是带罪之身，特来投奔柴大官人；望柴大官人收留...
Act8-1#6.t: You honour me too much, Lord Chai. I'm only a convict who has come to you for refuge. I hope you'll take us in...

Act8-1#7.zh: 那有什么问题！我柴进平生不好什么，就只好结交天下英雄好汉！我家传『誓书铁券』，就算是朝廷钦犯我也敢窝藏！林教头，请不要客气；您的家小我会妥善照顾的。
Act8-1#7.t: No trouble at all! There's nothing I love more than befriending the heroes of the land! My family holds the 'iron charter of immunity'; I'd shelter even a fugitive wanted by the court! Instructor Lin, don't stand on ceremony. I'll take good care of your family.

Act8-1#8.zh: 不瞒教头，小可乃大周柴世宗嫡派子孙。自陈桥让位有德，太祖武德皇帝敕赐誓书铁券在家，谁敢到我庄上拿人？
Act8-1#8.t: To be frank, Instructor, I am a direct descendant of Emperor Shizong of the Later Zhou. For yielding the throne at Chenqiao, our house was granted the iron charter by the Founding Emperor. Who would dare come to my manor to arrest anyone?

Act8-1#9.zh: 柴大官人之恩，林冲没齿难忘！
Act8-1#9.t: Lin Chong will never forget your kindness, Lord Chai!

Act8-1#10.zh: 旁边这几位是林教头朋友吧？先不要讲，让我猜一猜...这位少年英雄身刺龙纹，气宇昂扬...莫非是史家村『九纹龙』史进？
Act8-1#10.t: These gentlemen must be your friends, Instructor? Don't tell me, let me guess... This young hero has dragons tattooed on him and a proud bearing... Could he be 'Nine Dragons' Shi Jin of Shi Family Village?

Act8-1#11.t: You have a sharp eye, Lord Chai.

Act8-1#12.zh: 这位僧人能舞六十二斤的水磨禅杖；此等神力，天下少有...我是知道有一位鲁达鲁提辖有此神力，只不过他不是僧人啊...
Act8-1#12.t: This monk can swing a sixty-two-catty iron staff. Such strength is rare in this world... I know of a Major Lu Da with such power, but he's no monk...

Act8-1#13.zh: 在下正是鲁达。只不过因三拳打死镇关西，不得已出家；现在法名叫做『智深』。
Act8-1#13.t: I am Lu Da. I killed the 'Lord of the West' with three punches and had to become a monk. Now my name in religion is 'Zhishen'.

Act8-1#14.zh: 此位豪杰声音雄厚，内力十足；想必武艺超群。加上剑眉耸天，气宇非凡...天下有此等相貌者，莫非是『%M』%N？
Act8-1#14.t: This hero's voice is deep and full of inner strength; his martial skill must be outstanding. And those soaring sword brows, that extraordinary bearing... Could this be '%M' %N?

Act8-1#15.zh: 哈哈...柴大官人好眼力，正是在下。
Act8-1#15.t: Haha... you have a sharp eye, Lord Chai. That's me.

Act8-1#16.zh: 哪里哪里，这只不过是拿不上台面的雕虫小技罢了；在下虽然不敢自夸阅人无数，但是还知晓诸位天下英雄好汉...
Act8-1#16.t: Not at all, it's a petty trick unworthy of mention. I won't boast of having met countless people, but I do know the heroes of the land...

Act8-1#19.zh: (庄客称他为教师，必定是柴大官人的师父；我得客气一点。)
Act8-1#19.t: (The farmhands call him master. He must be Lord Chai's teacher. I'd better be polite.)

Act8-1#20.zh: 啊，洪教头，这位是东京八十万禁军教头，『豹子头』林冲。
Act8-1#20.t: Ah, Instructor Hong, this is Lin Chong, the 'Panther Head', instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards of Kaifeng.

Act8-1#22.zh: 林冲？那不是把京城闹得满城风雨的通缉犯吗？大官人只因好习枪棒，三教九流都上柴家庄不是骗吃骗喝，就是避避风头！柴家庄再这么下去不就变成流民收容所了吗！
Act8-1#22.t: Lin Chong? Isn't that the fugitive who's set the whole capital in an uproar? Just because my lord likes spear and staff, every sort of riffraff comes to the Chai manor to sponge meals or lie low! Keep this up and the Chai manor will become a refugee shelter!

Act8-1#24.zh: 真人不露相，洪教头可不要小看人了...
Act8-1#24.t: A true master doesn't show off. Don't underestimate him, Instructor Hong...

Act8-1#25.zh: 我不相信他有什么真本事！他敢跟我比一场，我才承认他有本事！
Act8-1#25.t: I don't believe he has any real skill! If he dares to fight me, then I'll admit he's any good!

Act8-1#26.zh: (不知道这个林冲的本事如何，乘这机会正可以瞧瞧...) 也好，也好。林武师，您的意下如何？
Act8-1#26.t: (I wonder how good this Lin Chong really is. Here's my chance to see...) Very well, very well. Master Lin, what do you say?

Act8-1#28.zh: (这个人一定是没有本事，一开始就怕了！)不要多说了。我到习武厅等你！
Act8-1#28.t: (He must have no real skill; he's scared already!) Enough talk. I'll wait for you in the training hall!

Act8-1#29.zh: 习武厅,林冲的本事即将经受严峻考验。
Act8-1#29.t: The training hall: Lin Chong's skill faces a stern test.
